title: Create denormalized materialized views for Console usage and cost dashboards
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Deliver a set of denormalized, materialized BigQuery views to power Console dashboards and downstream cost pipelines. Goals: 1) reduce average dashboard query latency to <500ms for top 95% of queries, 2) expose per-route and per-model token attribution for cost breakdowns, 3) enforce PII-safe fields and row-level partitioning to support fast incremental refreshes. Work includes: design of join keys and sessionization logic, dbt model implementation, partitioning/clustering strategy, backfill and incremental migration plan, and dashboard query templates for Console and billing teams. Avoid building overly wide fact tables that cause long JOINs; instead implement materialized aggregations at hourly/day granularity and a compact session table for ad-hoc join needs.
migration_plan: 1) Deploy dbt incremental models to dev and run smoke queries. 2) Backfill historical partitions in batches (30 days at a time) with monitored quota throttling. 3) Cutover read routes in Console to point queries at materialized views (canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%). 4) Deprecate old joins after 2 weeks of stable metrics.
partitioning_strategy: Partition by event_date (day) for daily MVs and hourly partitions for high-cardinality route-hour MV. Cluster on hashed_user_id and route for faster selective reads.
data_governance: PII rules: drop user_email, deterministic hash user_id with salt stored in KMS; remove raw prompt text unless allowlisted by product; add provenance columns (_ingest_ts, source_topic). Auditing: capture backfill window and operator in audit table.
performance_notes: Prototype queries on sample dataset indicate the route-day MV reducesJOIN time by ~70% compared to raw events; expected QPU cost savings ~40% for top-50 dashboards. Storage overhead estimated +12% due to denormalized copies but justified by query cost reduction.
testing_plan: Unit tests in dbt (not null, uniqueness on session_id, referential integrity for model_id), integration smoke tests against looker explore, add regression query benchmarks in nightly CI.
backfill_notes: Backfill will run in controlled 72-hour windows with a rollback plan that truncates newly populated partitions. For large tenants, perform tenant-wise backfills in off-peak windows.
